body.p: When Content Fusion with the AI Positron plugin installed is connected to a Git project that contains a positron-ai-actions or .contentfusion/positron-ai-actions folder, AI actions defined in those folders are automatically loaded by the AI Positron plugin and used to present custom AI actions and actions defined in excluded-action-ids.txt files are filtered out.

When working in an Oxygen Content Fusion project, AI Positron also loads custom actions from an ai-positron-actions folder located either in the project root or in .contentfusion/ai-positron-actions. If either of these folders also contains an ai-context.md file, its contents are automatically loaded as the project context prompt for new chats. Updates to the actions or context file are applied when you start a new chat.
